title: Rav Sama son of Rav Yeiva
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Bava Batra 9a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.9a.11), addressing Rav Papa as “Master”; Hyman infers from the passage that he was Rav Papa’s student.[^1]

notes.text: Rav Sama addresses Rav Papa as “Master” in a discussion of assistance for a poor man. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2806&lang=en) also records the exchange. The claim of discipleship is Hyman’s inference.
